payload.answer: The [path] page is always server-rendered with its h1 'Ask my résumé', a short intro (answers only from what is on the site; six questions per session), and links to [path] and [path] When GET [path] reports enabled:false (or fetch fails, or a bot user agent is detected), the page variant of AskAdam renders a visible notice inside the same card — 'Ask my résumé is resting right now' with links to [path] and [path] — instead of rendering null as the homepage widget does. Never a blank page; locally and in tests the bot is disabled so this state must look intentional.
